In the run-up to the [[2025 Dutch general election]], various organisations are carrying out [[opinion polling]] to gauge voting intentions in the [[Netherlands]]. Results of such polls are displayed in this list.

The date range for these opinion polls are from the [[2023 Dutch general election]], held on 22 November, to the present. Four main pollsters have performed opinion polls on voting intentions in the Netherlands during this period, these being: I&O Research, Ipsos, Peil.nl and Verian. I&O Research and Ipsos merged in January 2024, polling separately until July when they decided to poll together under the name Ipsos I&O.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ipsos-publiek.nl/actueel/ipsos-nederland-en-io-gaan-samen-verder-als-ipsos-io/ |title=Ipsos Nederland en I&O gaan samen verder als Ipsos I&O |date=8 January 2024 |access-date=27 December 2024 |work=ipsos-publiek.nl |language=nl}}</ref> Peil.nl does not give percentages, only showing seats while the other pollsters do include percentages.

== Political polling in the Netherlands ==
The political polling industry in the Netherlands is generally considered reliable. Absolute Total Raw Error in selected past elections has ranged from 11.8% to 16.0%, comparable to the European average. Documented conflicts of interest are rare, although peil.nl has been criticized for underrepresenting certain demographic groups in its samples.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Rogowiecki |first1=Jakub |title=Europe Elects. Truth in Polling. FINAL PUBLIC REPORT |url=https://europeelects.eu/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/EE_Truth-in-Polling-Final-Public-Report.pdf |website=Europe Elects |access-date=25 August 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Europe Elects |title=Europe Elects. Truth in Polling |url=https://europeelects.eu/europe-elects-truth-in-polling/ |publisher=Europe Elects |access-date=25 August 2025}}</ref>

== Projections ==
=== Graphical summary ===
The averages in the graphs below were constructed using polls listed below conducted by the four major Dutch pollsters. The trendlines show [[local regression]]s representing seat totals (not vote percentages).

[[File:Opinion polls NL 2023-2025.svg|800px|Seats]]

=== Seats ===
There are 150 seats in total, 76 seats are needed for a majority. Parties are denoted with a dash if no indication is given of their level in the polls.
